providers.name: Gain (formerly Gain.pro)
providers.setup: Obtain the MCP URL and authentication instructions from your Gain account manager. Public product page confirms MCP, but does not publish an endpoint.
providers.pricing: Quote required; no verified public numeric MCP tariff found. Free platform trial advertised; MCP inclusion, duration and permitted use require confirmation.
providers.trial: Free trial advertised; MCP entitlement unverified

providers.name: DEDALE Intelligence
providers.setup: Request the account-specific MCP setup from DEDALE. Public announcement confirms a read-only integration with account-level access controls, but supplies no server URL.
providers.pricing: Quote required; no verified public numeric MCP tariff or free MCP trial found.
providers.trial: Demo/introduction offered; free MCP trial unverified

providers.name: S&P Global / Kensho LLM-ready API
providers.setup: Use the S&P Global connector in Claude and sign in with provisioned Kensho Okta credentials. Custom clients may use an access token; provisioning and dataset entitlements are required.
providers.pricing: Quote required; official custom integration documentation directs access-level pricing to an S&P representative. Existing Capital IQ desktop access does not establish API/MCP entitlement.
providers.trial: Trial enquiries explicitly offered at https://llmreadyapi.kensho.com/
